aboutPage.title: Building for Better Life Since 2008
aboutPage.description: Wjeen International Construction Company, Ltd. is a Saudi general contractor headquartered in Jeddah, with branch offices in Yanbu, Riyadh, Jubail and Ras Tanura.

president.quote: Our main goals are commitment to our promises, perfection in our work and on-time delivery — aiming always to be favoured by our clients' satisfaction.
president.body1: We are pleased to introduce Wjeen International Construction Company, prepared with pride to fulfil our clients' needs in the world of general construction. Our continuous efforts help and assist our clients in offering top-notch projects, services and systems, crowned through our partners' experience.
president.body2: Our structuring is built with minutia to cope with diversified projects within our specialty. Our manpower is selected through a careful process to ensure quality and meet contingency plans, and our systems are woven to our size and aspirations to ensure effectiveness in teamwork, with an upper hand in planning and controlling.
president.name: Eng. Ismail ibn Abd Allah AlSayed

story.title: A Joint Venture Built on Three Decades of Experience
story.body1: Wjeen International Construction Company, Ltd. was founded in 2008. The headquarters is in Jeddah in the western region of Saudi Arabia, with branch offices in Yanbu, Riyadh, Jubail and Ras Tanura in the eastern region.
story.body2: Wjeen is a joint venture between Arabian Fal Company for Contracting and Trading — one of the largest contracting firms in Saudi Arabia, founded in 1979 with close to 4,000 multinational employees — and Eng. Ismail ibn Abd Allah AlSayed, a businessman with more than thirty years of experience across engineering consultancy, media, trading, contracting and manufacturing.
story.body3: That union gives our clients a superior level of service and a higher level of finished product. Wjeen provides the experience, expertise, manpower, equipment, tools and financial backing to meet construction requirements primarily in industrial and infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.
